name: Cyclic Mend
description: Turn a ring of mending qi through an ally's wounds until the flesh has closed.

name: Cyclic Guard
description: Wear a ring of qi that renews itself each time a blow cracks it.

name: Cyclic Sense
description: Read the turn of the wheel in every body nearby and know who is near an ending.

name: Cyclic Snare
description: Wind a ring of qi round a foe that tightens with each turn they make.

name: Cyclic Revive
description: Call a newly fallen ally back through one full turn of the wheel before the window closes.

name: Cyclic Purge
description: Turn the wheel over a group of allies until poison, taint and curse are carried away.

name: Cyclic Blast
description: Release a ring of stored qi that blasts outward and then draws back toward the user.

name: Cyclic Thrust
description: Thrust a line of qi through the guard that curves back to strike the same wound again.

name: Cyclic Absorb
description: Take the force of a hard blow into the wheel and return it as strength to the user.

name: Cyclic Phase
description: Pass through the foe's blow on the turn of the wheel and come out behind it.

name: Cyclic Overflow
description: Overflow the wheel's store into allies so each gains strength for their next effort.

name: Rebirth Herald
description: Stand as the herald of rebirth and lift fallen allies as the wheel turns.

name: Host Revival
description: Call back an army-sized host of allies fallen within the window, the widest ceiling of the tier.

name: Final Mend
description: Close every wound on an ally with a final slow turn of the wheel.

name: Final Guard
description: Wear the last turn of the wheel as a guard that holds while the rest breaks.

name: Final Reading
description: Read how many turns of the wheel any living being has left to take.

name: Final Ring
description: Seal a foe's qi inside a closing ring so it cannot be spent.

name: Final Raise
description: Raise a newly fallen ally whose breath stopped only a few moments before the call.

name: Final Purge
description: Purge a curse, a poison and a taint from an ally in a single turn.

name: Final Crush
description: Roll the wheel's final weight onto one foe in a crushing blow.

name: Final Sweep
description: Sweep a wide ring of qi that knocks all foes from their feet and sets them turning.

name: Final Absorb
description: Swallow a mighty blow into the final ring and hold its force without harm.

name: Final Flash
description: Flash across the field to a fallen ally's side on the last turn of the wheel.

name: Final Gift
description: Give an ally the whole stored turn of the wheel as a surge of strength.

name: Wheel Herald
description: Walk as the herald of the last turn, lifting the fallen and scattering their killers.

name: Wheel Sunder
description: Break the wheel outward at the ceiling of the divine tier, sundering everything across a field.

name: Return Ascendant
description: Raise the fallen in their hundreds within the window, the widest ceiling of the divine tier.
